data.short_meaning: Truthful, One Who Affirms the Truth
data.long_meaning: Musadiq is a Quranic Arabic name meaning 'one who confirms the truth'. It is used in the Quran to describe those who affirmed the previous scriptures or messages, symbolizing integrity and belief in divine truth. The name Musadiq carries the meaning “Truthful, One Who Affirms the Truth” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Musadiq usually hope their child will grow to embody truthful, one who affirms the truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who stands for truth and verifies righteousness — spiritually aligned with divine justice.
data.etymology: Musadiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Truthful, One Who Affirms the Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Musadiq total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
